latin: Per canem nihil aliud intelligit Zoroaster quam partem inrationalem animae et proportionalia, quod ita esse uidebit qui diligenter dicta omnia expositorum considerauerit, qui et ipsi, sicut et Zoroaster, enigmatice loquuntur.
translation: By the dog Zoroaster understands nothing other than the irrational part of the soul and things proportionate to it, as anyone will see who carefully considers all the sayings of the expositors, who themselves, like Zoroaster, speak enigmatically.
